name: hdie_pc_ctrl_bw_n64-n64-COMMIT
purpose: SAFE n64 structural redesign: 27 right-width 128x64 SRAM macros (3.8 pins/um faces) on the 43.2 lattice, 7 columns x 4 rows at 86.4 um pitch (52.7 um pin channels, 58.8 um row gaps), full-width central std-cell band y157.2..216; replaces the 13 mostly-tied 128x256 macros (10 pins/um). Gate first; submit only after production bench + mutants bound.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_svc_pc_ctrl_leaf_cfg_safe_legacy #(.OREG(1), .KREG(1), .KRREG(1), .RREG(1), .WPAY(1), .RESET_LANDING(2)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/ot_hbm_svc_pc_ctrl_leaf_cfg_safe.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/ot_hbm_svc_ring_h9b.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/ot_hbm_svc_pin_skid2_h9.sv rtl/model_ready_hbm_r14/ot_hbm_r14_aq_pc_safe.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/ot_hbm_svc_ring_bw_safe.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/ot_hbm_svc_pin_skid2_bw_safe.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/ot_hbm_svc_kr_ready_bridge.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/ot_hbm_svc_pc_ctrl_leaf_cfg_safe_legacy.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/ot_hbm_svc_sram128_n64.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w2c_128x64_m1/ot_sram_1r1w2c_128x64_m1_bb.v && echo lint-ok

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hdie_pc_ctrl_bw_n64/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hdie_pc_ctrl_bw_n64/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

no_bench_reason: Synthesis/floorplan diagnostic only; submit remains prohibited until production bench and committed mutant witnesses are bound.
structural_change: SAFE n64: every controller store (write/response payload 256b, 4-bank head/post metadata 79b, pending/response identity 21b, AQ queue 30b) is a ceil(W/64) x ot_sram_1r1w2c_128x64_m1 array (27 macros, 25.1k um2 vs 50.6k). Macro faces 105 pins/27.576 um = 3.8/um (old 410/41.064 = 10/um); no 177/235/226-bit tied padding. Same registered read edge, zero added cycles. Base RTL cc723735d (regional head_bank_cfg/row selector fanout successors).

reroute_reason.why: Structural SAFE redesign after failed safe3/safe4 gates and map4-6 fanout/macro-face failures: right-width 128x64 macros, new 648x302.4 macro-row floorplan with central full-width band; no fence.
